annotations.title: 2 August 2027 total solar eclipse at a place

description: Compute the total solar eclipse of 2 August 2027 at a place: total or partial, magnitude, contact times in local time, duration of totality and Sun height. Use it for that eclipse only: total from Spain and Morocco to Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Yemen, partial over Europe. Give a city (830 known) or coordinates. Computed locally, no network call.

city.description: City name, e.g. Louxor, Cadix, Tanger, Paris. Omit it to use lat/lon.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

lat.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (north positive).

lng.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

lon.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

name: eclipse_2027

outputSchema.description: Returns place, country, type_here (totale | partielle | aucune), magnitude, obscuration_pct, first_contact, totality_start, maximum, totality_end, last_contact, totality_s, sun_at_maximum, visible_verdict, safety.

title: 2 August 2027 total solar eclipse at a place
